objective: One-update four-A100 causal mechanics preflight for a frozen projected-value to recurrent-RWKV-read low-rank InfoNCE compatibility head.

authorization_basis.geometry_screen_outcome: passed geometry optimization but explicitly did not authorize causal or generation evaluation.

frozen_inputs.schedule_rows: first four source/donor pairs from inherited open-fit schedule step 1

architecture.initialization: Down normal(0,1/sqrt(32)); Up zero; exact no-op

training.control_branch_graph_serialization: controls execute with no_grad before the one InfoNCE backward

causal_controls.correct: target projected carrier plus target recurrent state
causal_controls.zero: target projected carrier plus explicit zero recurrent tensors
causal_controls.donor: target projected carrier plus matched-donor recurrent state
causal_controls.layer_permuted: target projected carrier plus cyclically permuted target recurrent layers
causal_controls.carrier_invariant: projected carrier reference identity must remain fixed on zero, donor, and layer-permuted branches
causal_controls.ce_control_interpretation: Mechanics-only fixed-carrier diagnostics; frozen answer CE controls do not include the compatibility head.

stopping_rule.pass: Produces only a signed mechanics preflight. It does not authorize an eight-update causal train, held-out endpoint, or generation benchmark.
stopping_rule.fail: Block all subsequent causal and generation runs.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, strength holdout, or any protected split.
